name: Tidio
tagline: Live chat and an AI agent for customer conversations
description: Tidio combines AI and human conversations on one platform, with the Lyro AI Agent answering common questions and no-code Flows for conversion paths.
features: Lyro AI Agent answers common questions and performs recurring tasks
Flows: no-code conversion paths triggered at key moments
useCases: Handing conversations to a human agent
strengths: A free plan and a 7-day trial without a card (per the page)
Plan limits are stated as numbers of billable conversations
limitations: Annual prices were not stated on the page we read
Lyro AI conversations are sold as an add-on beyond a small free allowance

free.details: Free: 50 billable conversations and 10 seats; the first 50 Lyro AI conversations are free (lifetime); the first 100 visitors reached via Flows are free.

pricing.trial: A 7-day free trial is offered without a credit card; the account then downgrades to Free unless upgraded.

plans.name: Starter
plans.billing: Shown on the monthly view; the annual price was not stated
plans.note: Annual-billing equivalent per month (2 months free). The monthly-billing price was not captured. 100 billable conversations a month.

plans.name: Growth
plans.note: Annual-billing equivalent per month (2 months free). The monthly-billing price was not captured.

plans.name: Plus
plans.note: Starts at $300 per month plus monthly usage; custom conversations and seats

plans.name: Premium
plans.note: Contact for pricing; from 3,000 Lyro AI conversations

plans.name: Lyro AI Agent add-on
plans.note: Starts at $32.50 per month for 50 Lyro AI conversations

pricing.regional: Prices were shown in USD. A toggle offers annual billing with 2 months free, but annual prices were not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Free plan (50 billable conversations, 7-day trial) confirmed. The paid cards sit behind a Monthly / Annually (2 months free) toggle: Starter shows $24.17 a month, which equals $29 less 2 months free, so it is an annual-equivalent figure rather than a monthly price. Corrected: the stored Starter $24.17 and Growth $49.17 were labelled monthly; they are now recorded as annual-equivalent and the monthly prices are marked not captured.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Customer chat, an AI agent and sales flows for online stores

capabilities.title: Answer shoppers with an AI agent
capabilities.text: Lyro answers questions using your store data: FAQs, order status, product details, website content and brand guidelines.

capabilities.title: Recommend products in chat
capabilities.text: Lyro shows product cards and can take real-time actions with Smart Actions, such as order updates and lead qualification.

capabilities.title: Start chats at the right moment
capabilities.text: Sales Flows open chats from behavioural triggers, cart nudges and exit intent.

capabilities.title: Answer on every channel in one inbox
capabilities.text: Help Desk brings live chat, email, WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook Messenger together.

featureCards.name: Smart redirections
featureCards.text: When Lyro is unsure it says so and passes the conversation to a person with context.

featureCards.name: Sales Flows templates
featureCards.text: A drag-and-drop canvas with 40+ ecommerce templates and no code.

featureCards.name: Order management
featureCards.text: Preview carts, check order history and offer discounts without leaving the conversation.

featureCards.name: Sales analytics
featureCards.text: Attributes sales, leads and satisfaction to conversations, by channel and by operator.

featureCards.name: Customisation and integrations
featureCards.text: Widget branding and language controls, 120+ integrations, Zapier and an OpenAPI.

featureCards.name: Compliance
featureCards.text: The site lists GDPR, AI Pact, CCPA and SOC 2.

audienceDetail.text: Businesses that sell through conversations, especially ecommerce brands.
These platforms are named for the free plan.
The site mentions custom AI agents, priority service levels and deeper integrations.

scenarios.title: Answer order and product questions
scenarios.text: Let the AI agent handle repeat questions automatically.

scenarios.title: Recover abandoned carts
scenarios.text: Trigger a chat on exit intent or a cart nudge.

scenarios.title: Hand off hard cases
scenarios.text: Route complex conversations from the AI to a person.

gettingStarted.text: Register in the Tidio panel; the page says no credit card is required.
Shopify, WordPress and Wix are named.

gettingStarted.step: Build a flow from a template
gettingStarted.text: Pick an ecommerce template on the canvas.
The page offers a sales contact for larger needs and says you can cancel in two clicks.
